Cyclone.centralPressure.title: centralPressure
Cyclone.centralPressure.description: The central pressure of the cyclone during the time interval.

EnvironmentalPhenomenon.timeInterval.title: timeInterval
EnvironmentalPhenomenon.timeInterval.description: The timestamp of the phenomenon as a single point or time interval.

AtmosphericPhenomenon.base.title: base
AtmosphericPhenomenon.base.description: The base altitude of the phenomenon.

AtmosphericPhenomenon.direction.title: direction
AtmosphericPhenomenon.direction.description: The direction the phenomenon is moving.

Hurricane.category.title: category
Hurricane.category.description: The hurricane's category during the time interval, using Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale, a 1 to 5 rating based on a hurricane's sustained wind speed.

Cyclone.maxSurfaceWindSpeed.title: maxSurfaceWindSpeed
Cyclone.maxSurfaceWindSpeed.description: The maximum surface wind speed of the cyclone during the time interval.

Cyclone.windForce.title: windForce
Cyclone.windForce.description: Wind Force as classified on the Beaufort Scale (0-12) during the time interval.

TropicalCycloneAustralia.category.title: category
TropicalCycloneAustralia.category.description:
Strength of tropical cyclone during the time interval, based on Australian Bureau of Meteorology Category System where:
1 - tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 90-125 km/h
2 - tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 125-164 km/h
3 - severe tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 165-224 km/h
4 - severe tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land 225-279 km/h
5 - severe tropical cyclone, with typical gusts over flat land greater  than 280 km/h.

AtmosphericPhenomenon.altitude.title: altitude
AtmosphericPhenomenon.altitude.description: The maximum altitude of the phenomenon.

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

title: Cyclone
description: A cyclone (or tropical cyclone), a rapidly-rotating storm system characterized by a low-pressure center, strong winds, and a spiral arrangement of thunderstorms that produce heavy rain.
